objective.text: The primary objective of the SAME-R investigation was to quantify the sizes that the liquid smoke particulate achieves in low gravity and to relate the droplet size distribution to the smoke generation and smoke transport conditions in the experiment.
objective.quote: the primary objective of the SAME-R investigation was to quantify the sizes that the liquid smoke particulate achieves in low gravity and to relate the droplet size distribution to the smoke generation and smoke transport conditions in the experiment.

fuel.text: Pyrell, an intumescent fire-retardant foam, was used as a test material.
fuel.quote: Pyrell®, an intumescent fire-retardant foam by Foamex, was introduced to replace DBP samples

measurements.text: A new instrument, M-pass, was used to replace one of the two Commercial Diagnostic Enclosures.
measurements.quote: a new instrument, M-pass, developed in-house GRC, was used to replace one of the two Commercial Diagnostic Enclosures

safety_finding.text: Liquid aerosol smokes produced in microgravity will exhibit substantially larger droplet sizes than under the same conditions in normal gravity, which may result in some detectors not producing an alarm.
safety_finding.quote: liquid aerosol smokes produced in microgravity will exhibit substantially larger droplet sizes than under the same conditions in normal gravity (with a corresponding decrease in the particle number density for the same mass of smoke). The change in the size distribution and number density will, in turn, affect the response of the smoke detectors and possibly result in some detectors not producing an alarm when exposed to this smoke.

earth_benefits.text: The smoke detectors developed from the results can also be useful in other extreme environments on Earth, such as submarines or underwater laboratories.
earth_benefits.quote: The smoke detectors developed from the results of SAME can also be useful in other extreme environments on Earth, such as submarines or underwater laboratories.
